thread:
lucy: new onboarding ticket — user blocked by import/require mismatch in JS SDK docs.

ben: what happened?

lucy: they did `const SDK = require('redwood-inference')` then `new SDK()` and got `TypeError: SDK is not a constructor`.

docs-eng: that's the named vs default export problem. docs only show `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference'`.

arjun: also edge users see `ReferenceError: process is not defined` when bundling CJS. we need to call out the `/edge` ESM entry.

lucy: suggested quick copy: "Node (ESM): `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference'`. Node (CJS): `const { Client } = require('redwood-inference/cjs')`. Edge: `import { Client } from 'redwood-inference/edge'` — ESM-only, no `process`/`global`/`fs`."

ben: add explicit line: "SDK exports named symbols (Client, utils). There is no default export. Do not `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference'`"

docs-eng: will add a tiny table + FAQ blurb: "Why does `require('redwood-inference')` fail?" with troubleshooting steps.

arjun: TypeScript note: ESM -> `import type { ClientOptions } from 'redwood-inference'`. CJS+TS -> use JSDoc: `/** @type {import('redwood-inference').ClientOptions} */`.

lucy: also ask engineering to audit package.json `exports` so `require('redwood-inference')` doesn't resolve to ESM-only for older node.

devx-bot: Created issue RW-DX-1012: "docs: clarify JS SDK import styles (ESM/CJS/edge) and add smoke tests" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1012

docs-eng: I'll open the docs PR today. lucy, can you add a sample-app smoke test that runs the CJS snippet in CI?

lucy: yep — adding `ci/cjs-smoke.js` that runs `node` and asserts `typeof Client === 'function'`. will link PR.

ben: also include a quick diagnostic command in docs: `node -e "console.log(require('redwood-inference/cjs'))"` to show export shape.

docs-eng: PR will include snippets, the table, a one-line edge gotcha, and the FAQ. tagging eng-runtime to confirm wording for `/edge`.

lucy: thanks — small docs + test should cut down these onboarding tickets. will post links when PRs are up :rocket:
